sentences.en: Section A The disappointing results of many conventional road transport projects in Africa led some experts to rethink the strategy by which rural transport problems were to be tackled at the beginning of the 1980s.
sentences.zh: A节非洲许多传统公路运输项目的结果令人失望,导致一些专家重新考虑了1980年代初处理农村运输问题的战略。

sentences.en: A request for help in improving the availability of transport within the remote Makete District of south-western Tanzania presented the opportunity to try a new approach.
sentences.zh: 请求帮助改善坦桑尼亚西南部偏远的Makete区内交通的可用性,为尝试新的办法提供了机会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The concept of ‘integrated rural transport’ was adopted in the task of examining the transport needs of the rural households in the district.
sentences.zh: 在审查该区农村住户的运输需求时,采用了 " 农村综合运输 " 的概念。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The objective was to reduce the time and effort needed to obtain access to essential goods and services through an improved rural transport system.
sentences.zh: 目标是通过改善农村运输系统,减少获得基本货物和服务所需的时间和努力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The underlying assumption was that the time saved would be used instead for activities that would improve the social and economic development of the communities.
sentences.zh: 基本假设是,节省的时间将被用于改善社区的社会和经济发展的活动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The Makete Integrated Rural Transport Project (MIRTP) started in 1985 with financial support from the Swiss Development Corporation and was coordinated with the help of the Tanzanian government.
sentences.zh: 1985年,在瑞士开发公司的资助下,在坦桑尼亚政府的帮助下,启动了Makete农村综合运输项目。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Section B When the project began, Makete District was virtually totally isolated during the rainy season.
sentences.zh: 项目开始时,Makete区在雨季几乎完全被孤立。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

words.def: 项目项目项目项目项目

sentences.en: The regional road was in such bad shape that access to the main towns was impossible for about three months of the year.
sentences.zh: 区域道路状况如此糟糕,一年中大约三个月无法进入主要城镇。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Road traffic was extremely rare within the district, and alternative means of transport were restricted to donkeys in the north of the district.
sentences.zh: 该地区公路交通极为罕见,其他运输工具仅限于该地区北部的驴子。

sentences.en: People relied primarily on the paths, which were slippery and dangerous during the rains.
sentences.zh: 人们主要依靠道路,在雨季,道路滑滑而危险。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Before solutions could be proposed, the problems had to be understood.
sentences.zh: 在提出解决办法之前,必须理解问题。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Little was known about the transport demands of the rural households, so Phase I, between December 1985 and December 1987, focused on research.
sentences.zh: 农村家庭对运输的需求鲜为人知,因此1985年12月至1987年12月的第一阶段侧重于研究。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The socio-economic survey of more than 400 households in the district indicated that a household in Makete spent, on average, seven hours a day on transporting themselves and their goods, a figure which seemed extreme but which has also been obtained in surveys in other rural areas in Africa.
sentences.zh: 对该地区400多个家庭的社会经济调查表明,Makete的一个家庭平均每天花费7小时运输自己和货物,这一数字似乎极端极端,但在非洲其他农村地区调查中也得到了这一数据。

sentences.en: Interesting facts regarding transport were found: 95% was on foot; 80% was within the locality; and 70% was related to the collection of water and firewood and travelling to grinding mills.
sentences.zh: 发现了有关运输的有趣事实:95%的人步行;80%的人在附近;70%的人与取水和拾柴以及前往磨坊有关。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Section C Having determined the main transport needs, possible solutions were identified which might reduce the time and burden.
sentences.zh: C节确定了主要运输需要,确定了可能的解决办法,这些办法可以减少时间和负担。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: During Phase II, from January to February 1991, a number of approaches were implemented in an effort to improve mobility and access to transport.
sentences.zh: 在1991年1月至2月的第二阶段期间,为了改善交通流动和交通便利,采取了若干办法。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: An improvement of the road network was considered necessary to ensure the import and export of goods to the district.
sentences.zh: 据认为,有必要改善公路网,以确保货物进出口到该区。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: These improvements were carried out using methods that were heavily dependent on labour.
sentences.zh: 这些改进是采用严重依赖劳动力的方法进行的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: In addition to the improvement of roads, these methods provided training in the operation of a mechanical workshop and bus and truck services.
sentences.zh: 除了改善道路之外,这些方法还提供机械车间和公共汽车及卡车服务操作方面的培训。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, the difference from the conventional approach was that this time consideration was given to local transport needs outside the road network.
sentences.zh: 然而,与常规办法的不同之处在于,这次考虑的是公路网以外的当地运输需要。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Most goods were transported along the paths that provide short-cuts up and down the hillsides, but the paths were a real safety risk and made the journey on foot even more arduous.
sentences.zh: 大多数货物沿短径沿山坡上下行走,但道路确实有安全风险,徒步旅行更加艰难。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: It made sense to improve the paths by building steps, handrails and footbridges.
sentences.zh: 通过建造台阶、扶手和人行桥改善道路是有道理的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It was uncommon to find means of transport that were more efficient than walking but less technologically advanced than motor vehicles.
sentences.zh: 很难找到比步行效率更高的运输工具,但比机动车辆技术先进。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The use of bicycles was constrained by their high cost and the lack of available spare parts.
sentences.zh: 自行车费用高昂,缺乏备件,限制了自行车的使用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Oxen were not used at all but donkeys were used by a few households in the northern part of the district.
sentences.zh: 完全没有使用氧气,但区北部的几个家庭使用驴子。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: MIRTP focused on what would be most appropriate for the inhabitants of Makete in terms of what was available, how much they could afford and what they were willing to accept.
sentences.zh: 摩托提提方案的重点是,从现有条件、他们能承担多少费用和他们愿意接受什么方面来看,对马克特居民最合适的是什么。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: After careful consideration, the project chose the promotion of donkeys – a donkey costs less than a bicycle – and the introduction of a locally manufacturable wheelbarrow.
sentences.zh: 这个项目经过仔细考虑后,选择了促进驴子(驴子成本低于自行车成本)和引进当地制造的手推车。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

words.def: 审议审议情况审议审议

sentences.en: Section D At the end of Phase II, it was clear that the selected approaches to Makete’s transport problems had had different degrees of success.
sentences.zh: 在第二阶段结束时,显然,选择解决Makete运输问题的办法取得了不同程度的成功。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Phase III, from March 1991 to March 1993, focused on the refinement and institutionalisation of these activities.
sentences.zh: 第三阶段,即1991年3月至1993年3月,着重改进这些活动并使之制度化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The road improvements and accompanying maintenance system had helped make the district centre accessible throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 道路改善和配套的维修系统帮助区中心全年无障碍通行。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Essential goods from outside the district had become more readily available at the market, and prices did not fluctuate as much as they had done before.
sentences.zh: 该地区以外的基本商品在市场上更容易获得,价格波动幅度没有以前那么大。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Paths and secondary roads were improved only at the request of communities who were willing to participate in construction and maintenance.
sentences.zh: 道路和二级道路的改善只有在愿意参与建设和维护的社区提出要求时才能进行。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: However, the improved paths impressed the inhabitants, and requests for assistance greatly increased soon after only a few improvements had been completed.
sentences.zh: 然而,经过改善的道路给居民留下了深刻印象,在只完成了几条改进之后,很快又大量增加了援助请求。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The efforts to improve the efficiency of the existing transport services were not very successful because most of the motorised vehicles in the district broke down and there were no resources to repair them.
sentences.zh: 提高现有运输服务效率的努力并不十分成功,因为该地区大多数机动车辆破损,没有资源维修。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Even the introduction of low-cost means of transport was difficult because of the general poverty of the district.
sentences.zh: 由于该地区普遍贫困,甚至采用低成本运输手段也很难。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The locally manufactured wheelbarrows were still too expensive for all but a few of the households.
sentences.zh: 除了少数家庭外,当地制造的手推车对所有人都来说仍然太贵。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Modifications to the original design by local carpenters cut production time and costs.
sentences.zh: 当地木工对原设计所作的修改缩短了生产时间和成本。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Other local carpenters have been trained in the new design so that they can respond to requests.
sentences.zh: 其他当地木工也接受了新设计方面的培训,以便他们能够对要求作出反应。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, a locally produced wooden wheelbarrow which costs around 5000 Tanzanian shillings (less than US$20) in Makete, and is about one quarter the cost of a metal wheelbarrow, is still too expensive for most people.
sentences.zh: 然而,当地生产的木制手推车对大多数人来说仍然太昂贵,它花费在马克特大约5000坦桑尼亚先令(不到20美元),大约是金属手推车成本的四分之一。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Donkeys, which were imported to the district, have become more common and contribute, in particular, to the transportation of crops and goods to market.
sentences.zh: 向该区进口的驴子越来越普遍,尤其有助于将作物和货物运往市场。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Those who have bought donkeys are mainly from richer households but with an increased supply through local breeding, donkeys should become more affordable.
sentences.zh: 购买驴子的人主要来自富裕的家庭,但是随着当地育种增加供应,驴子应该更容易负担得起。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, local initiatives are promoting the renting out of the existing donkeys.
sentences.zh: 同时,地方倡议正在推动从现有驴子中租出。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It should be noted, however that a donkey, which at 20,000 Tanzanian shillings costs less than a bicycle, is still an investment equal to an average household’s income over half a year This clearly illustrates the need for supplementary measures if one wants to assist the rural poor.
sentences.zh: 不过,应该指出,一头驴,其成本比自行车低20 000坦桑尼亚先令,仍相当于半年家庭平均收入的投资,这清楚地表明,如果想帮助农村穷人,必须采取补充措施。

sentences.en: Section E It would have been easy to criticise the MIRTP for using in the early phases a ‘top-down’ approach, in which decisions were made by experts and officials before being handed down to communities, but it was necessary to start the process from the level of the governmental authorities of the district.
sentences.zh: E节很容易批评MIRTP在早期阶段使用 " 自上而下 " 的办法,即专家和官员在将决定权交给社区之前先由专家和官员作出决定,但必须从该区政府当局一级开始这一进程。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
